posts.title: If Speed is your Metric
posts.description: If speed is your one true metric for delivery, you are missing out on so many other metrics you could be measuring your team by. Quality. Sustainability. Performance. Security. posts.title: Throwaway Code
posts.description: When someone wanted some work done quickly, we called it “Throwaway Code” – it wouldn’t integrate with anything you have, it would stand alone, it would just exist. It could do one thing only, and after that it would be thrown away and/or rebuilt, because it couldn’t stand the test of time. Fast forward to ... Read more
